mobbin:7b9d5db3-24d8-49ae-827e-218db2b44.summary: User sees a vehicle home dominated by battery %, uses Lock/Unlock or Climate/Energy shortcuts, scrolls a 2×2 status-widget grid, then opens a vehicle menu where Updates is the highlighted action item.
steps: Widget grid — Climate / Energy / Gear Guard / Location
Vehicle menu — Drivers and keys + secondary links
steal: Step 1: One status dominates (large battery %) — single primary glance metric, not a KPI strip.
Step 1: Single primary action pair is Lock/Unlock under the asset; secondary module tiles (Climate/Energy) sit below.
Step 4: Each widget shows status line + one-tap circular action (fan, charge, camera, map).
Step 3/5: Updates card uses color to surface a pending action above otherwise muted menu rows.
avoid: Equal-weight colorful 2×2 widget grid (step 4) can become clutter if every module tile fights for attention — conflicts with product-owner show little, but precisely.
mobbin:7b9d5db3-24d8-49ae-827e-218db2b44.fit: Dominant health % + one primary action is the dashboard system-health / center-overview pattern (All systems OK vs N rooms failing); Lock/Unlock maps to start/stop Recording readiness, Climate/Energy-style tiles hand off to Scheduling or Reports, Updates-style alerts stay dashboard-only action items.
